content: अवघातः [अव हन्-घञ्] .²1 Striking. .²2 Hurting, killing. .²3 A violent or sharp blow, stroke or blow in general; कर्णावघातनिपुणेन च ताड्यमाना दूरीकृताः करिवरेण (भृङ्गाः) <ls>Nītipr. 2</ls>; अधरे दत्तदन्तावघाते <ls>S. D.</ls> .²4 Threshing corn by bruising it with a wooden pestle in a mortar. .²5 Unnatural or accidental death.
